title: Enterprise Support: Compute contract price evidence for retained-fee cash return
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute contract price evidence for retained-fee cash return.

## Decision basis

For retained-fee cash return: Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same legal billing entity; use its authorized signed negotiated unit rate, otherwise its tier standard primary unit rate. With no matching compute contract use zero and do not recognize a compute spending contribution.

For retained-fee cash return: This reconstruction values actual exported compute usage; it does not grant a support discount.

## Points of judgment

For retained-fee cash return: An authorized negotiated price on the matching active compute contract supplies the selected price; otherwise the selected price comes from that contract’s tier. The matching contract belongs to the same customer and legal billing entity.
